body:
Effectively, when embedded and floating, the floating window size does not follow the project settings. I believe this could be fixed relatively easily. However, one of the current features is that when you resize the floating window, the size and position are saved and reused for the next play session. Personally, I find this feature useful because it’s easier to resize and position the game window using the floating window rather than manually updating the values in the project settings (which might include size, position, and screen settings, if I remember correctly).

Do you think Godot should stop preserving the size and position of the floating window and always use the project settings? Or perhaps a new toggle could be added to indicate whether you want to use the project settings or not?
